Hey Divya, I really enjoyed our chat today. It helped me see the project differently, and I feel a lot clearer about what to do next. Thank you for taking the time, it meant a lot.

Hi Rohit, congratulations on the promotion, so well deserved! You worked so hard for this. Let's celebrate when you are back in town.

Hi team, thank you all for the effort this sprint. I know it was a tough one, and I am proud of how everyone pulled together.

form.ask: How does your team handle on-call and incident reviews?
form.writingSamples:
Quick question on the retry logic: are we using exponential backoff with jitter, or a fixed delay? Asking because the fixed delay caused a thundering herd last quarter.

I looked into the slow query. The index was there but the planner skipped it because of the type cast. Fixed it in the PR, benchmarks attached.

Curious why we picked Kafka over a plain queue here. Was it ordering guarantees, or throughput? Happy to read the design doc if there is one.
